honest_limits: our attacks against our own package, on an in-process approval server; this shows the gate holds against this list, not that the list is complete

rows.attacker_tried: call the wrapped tool with no approval token
rows.name: no token

rows.attacker_tried: invent a token with the right shape
rows.name: forged token

rows.attacker_tried: spend a token approved for mode SOFT on mode HARD
rows.name: binding mismatch, escalated args

rows.attacker_tried: spend a REAL minted token whose card has since been denied
rows.name: token from a denied card

rows.attacker_tried: approve a card whose expiry is already past, then write
rows.name: expired token

rows.attacker_tried: hold a valid token but call from an unauthorised credential
rows.name: valid token, unauthorised credential

rows.attacker_tried: have the agent approve its own card (server refused to mint)
rows.name: self-approval, maker equals checker

rows.attacker_tried: re-register a DENIED card (status after: DENIED)
rows.name: resurrect a decided card

rows.attacker_tried: spend one approved token twice under two idempotency keys
rows.name: token replay for a second execution

rows.attacker_tried: race 12 concurrent spends of one token (1 landed)
rows.name: race the single-use spend

rows.attacker_tried: rewrite the card after approval and spend the original token
rows.name: card mutated after approval

rows.attacker_tried: call a tool whose action class has no policy row, holding a valid token
rows.name: action class with no policy row

threat_model: the calling process is compromised: any tool, any arguments, any string, any replay; the approval server's pepper cannot be forged
why_this_file_exists: two of these attacks (G07 self-approval and G08 card resurrection) landed on this package while the system it was extracted from refused them, and the conformance suite could not see it because it never offered a non-human principal or re-registered a decided card
